name: io.github.openagentemail/mcp
description: Unlimited agent mailboxes — create identities, read/wait for mail, extract OTPs, send email.

environmentVariables.name: OPENAGENTEMAIL_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Bearer key for the openagent.email API — best: the identity token (oa_…) returned by POST /v1/identities.

environmentVariables.name: OPENAGENTEMAIL_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the openagent.email API.
